decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line is a well-supported multi-variant extension of the firm’s core natural skincare range and, having remained in the assortment, looks strategically established.

The hyaluronic acid facial serum fits current demand for simple, effective facial care and is close enough to the firm’s established offer that it is likely to stay despite only moderate website prominence.
The facial cleansing milk matches the firm’s gentle-care positioning, but as a less prominently presented single product it still carries some rationalisation risk in a small firm’s portfolio review.
The facial cleansing oil is a recent launch within the firm’s core cleansing segment and is likely to be retained while the firm continues to test and build demand for it.
